title: Molecular mechanism of aloe emodin in combating nasopharyngeal carcinoma revealed through network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vitro experiments.
authors: Xin, Zeng; Li, Chunhong; Li, Mengqin; Huang, Yuping; Tang, Jianhong
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学、分子对接和体外实验研究芦荟大黄素抑制鼻咽癌的机制，虽涉及分子对接但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: The aim is to study the mechanism by which aloe emodin (AE) inhibits nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) through regulating the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)/SRC proto-oncogene (SRC)/signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) signaling pathway and programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression. The methods are to predict AE target sites and NPC disease targets using a comprehensive database, construct protein interaction networks, and perform enrichment analysis and validate findings through molecular docking and in vitro experiments. Network pharmacology analysis identified 27 potential targets of AE acting on NPC, screening out 10 core targets including EGFR, SRC, and STAT3, which are closely associated with tumor signaling. KEGG enrichment analysis suggested AE may exert effects by regulating EGFR, mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK), and interleukin-17 (IL-17)-related pathways. Molecular docking revealed that AE exhibits strong binding activity against these core targets. In vitro validation showed that AE significantly suppressed the phosphorylation levels of EGFR, SRC, and STAT3, as well as PD-L1 expression, in NPC C666-1 and CNE1 cells, while reducing cell viability and migration capacity. Overexpression of STAT3 significantly attenuated AE's inhibitory effects on cell proliferation and motility, further confirming STAT3 as a key target for AE's mechanism of action. This study elucidates the multi-target mechanism of AE against NPC, with the EGFR/SRC/STAT3 axis identified as a critical downstream effector and its downstream PD-L1 expression, providing experimental evidence for its development as a natural antitumor drug.
abstract_zh: 旨在研究芦荟大黄素（AE）通过调控表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）/SRC原癌基因（SRC）/信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）信号通路及程序性死亡配体1（PD-L1）表达抑制鼻咽癌（NPC）的机制。方法为利用综合数据库预测AE靶点及NPC疾病靶点，构建蛋白质相互作用网络，进行富集分析，并通过分子对接和体外实验验证发现。网络药理学分析识别出AE作用于NPC的27个潜在靶点，筛选出包括EGFR、SRC和STAT3在内的10个核心靶点，这些靶点与肿瘤信号传导密切相关。KEGG富集分析提示AE可能通过调控EGFR、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）及白细胞介素-17（IL-17）相关通路发挥作用。分子对接显示AE对这些核心靶点具有强结合活性。体外验证表明，AE显著抑制NPC C666-1和CNE1细胞中EGFR、SRC和STAT3的磷酸化水平及PD-L1表达，同时降低细胞活力和迁移能力。STAT3过表达显著减弱AE对细胞增殖和运动能力的抑制作用，进一步确认STAT3为AE作用机制的关键靶点。本研究阐明了AE抗NPC的多靶点机制，其中EGFR/SRC/STAT3轴被确定为其关键下游效应因子及其下游PD-L1表达，为其作为天然抗肿瘤药物的开发提供了实验依据。
